people.name: Edom
people.line: Descendants of Esau; enemy nation southeast of Israel

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Seir
people.line: Region inhabited by Edomites, descendants of Esau

translations.web: Edom shall be a possession. Seir, his enemies, also shall be a possession, while Israel does valiantly.
translations.bsb: Edom will become a possession, as will Seir, his enemy; but Israel will perform with valor.
translations.kjv: And Edom shall be a possession, Seir also shall be a possession for his enemies; and Israel shall do valiantly.
translations.asv: And Edom shall be a possession, Seir also shall be a possession, who were his enemies; While Israel doeth valiantly.
